# Hero Memories Photos

Place your kid's birthday photos inside this `public/images/` folder to show real photos in the app!

Supported photos:
- `/images/hero1.jpg` (or `/images/hero1.svg`)
- `/images/hero2.jpg` (or `/images/hero2.svg`)
- `/images/hero3.jpg` (or `/images/hero3.svg`)

Simply drop your JPG/PNG files here with these names!
